Prices are estimates only and are not intended as actual price quotes. Actual pricing may vary depending on the type of agreement entered with Microsoft, date of purchase, and the currency exchange rate. Prices are calculated based on US dollars and converted using London closing spot rates that are captured in the two business days prior to the last business day of the previous month end. If the two business days prior to the end of the month fall on a bank holiday in major markets, the rate setting day is generally the day immediately preceding the two business days. This rate applies to all transactions during the upcoming month. Sign in to the Azure pricing calculator to see pricing based on your current program/offer with Microsoft. Contact an Azure sales specialist for more information on pricing or to request a price quote. See frequently asked questions about Azure pricing.

Frequently asked questions about Azure pricing
What is Observability in Foundry Control Plane?
Observability in Foundry Control Plane is a suite of capabilities for monitoring, tracing, evaluating, red teaming and governing AI agents and applications. It provides end-to-end visibility across the entire AI lifecycle—from prototyping and development to production—enabling teams to debug, optimize, and ensure the reliability and safety of AI agents.
How is monitoring and tracing billed in Azure AI Foundry?
There is no charge for monitoring in Azure AI Foundry. Tracing in Azure AI Foundry requires connecting to Application Insights resource and there is no additional charge in Azure AI Foundry. Please check out pricing for Azure Monitor logs pricing her
[... excerpt boundary ...]
re AI Foundry?
Azure AI Foundry supports different kinds of evaluators including agent evaluator, risk and safety evaluators, General purpose evaluators and more. Learn more about supported evaluators here.
What type of evaluations are billed via the AI evaluations meter?
Only safety, red teaming and playground evaluations are billed using the AI evaluations meter. All other cloud evaluations including quality and continuous evaluations are billed using input and output tokens (with no surcharge) with bring your own judge model deployment.
